tool.name: GSASII Refinement: ouput generator
tool.description: Tool for generating CIF files from a GSASII project file used after completion of a Rietveld refinement
tool.command: conda init bash && source ../home/.bashrc && conda activate GSASII && mkdir app && cd app/ && touch $output && mkdir -p portal/cifs portal/csvs && ln -s $project gsas_project.gpx && python $__tool_directory__/gsas2_gpx_output.py --project-filename gsas_project.gpx --output-directory /portal > >(tee -a $output) 2> >(tee -a $output >&2)
tool.help: A tool to generate CIF files from a GSASII project file. This tool is intended to be called from the GSASII interactive refinement tool.
